prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game GUI facility background candidate for a JRPG static prototype
Primary request: Create a wide 16:9 mature fantasy anime JRPG background for the Ice-region storage facility, display name: 港口倉庫. This is a new v01 candidate, not a replacement of an existing asset.
Scene/backdrop: Frost-tide harbor warehouse interior with no character: wet dark timber beams, rope coils, cargo crates, barrels, pulley hooks, wrapped parcels, brass lanterns, salt frost, ledger desk, stone floor reflections, sea-fogged arched door/window on the left with distant cold harbor silhouettes. Preserve readable left and middle background depth for GUI panels.
Primary focus: center-right stacked cargo and warehouse counter area, with enough negative space and depth to survive GUI overlay cropping.
Style/medium: polished 2D anime fantasy game background, painterly JRPG facility art, mature and grounded, detailed but not cluttered, matching existing fantasy facility GUI mood.
Composition/framing: 1672x941 target aspect. No NPC. Keep focal cargo and tools center-right/lower-right, left side readable as harbor warehouse depth, no oversized foreground object blocking GUI panels.
Lighting/mood: cold blue harbor light plus warm amber brass lanterns, damp winter storage atmosphere.
Constraints: no in-image text, no readable signs, no UI panels, no logos, no runtime IDs, no watermark.
negative_prompt: text, captions, logo, UI panels, signs with readable words, runtime IDs, character, portrait, cropped face, plain white snowfield, empty ice cave, modern objects, unreadable clutter, overexposed pure white ice, image with no usable left/middle background depth.
agent_notes: Candidate v01 treats storage as a no-NPC facility, using harbor cargo and wet warehouse depth as the main visual focus. It is not installed as the GUI background.
